plainTranslation: Composite Jupiter in the 7 House: With Composite Jupiter in the 7th house, this is the house of relationships, so this is one of the best placements you can have for any relationship. You can genuinely like one another, who you are in the relationship, and the relationship itself. You can treat each other as equals, and you can make compromises and keep the peace. You can find commitment easier in a personal relationship, and you can enjoy the time you spend together one-on-one.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
